text_ja: 第一項及び前項の「Tier2資本調達手段」とは、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす資本調達手段(普通株式又はその他Tier1資本調達手段に該当するものを除く。)をいう。一発行者により現に発行され、かつ、払込済みのものであること。二残余財産の分配又は倒産処理手続における債務の弁済若しくは内容の変更について、発行者の他の債務(その他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段に該当する債務を除く。)に対して劣後的内容を有するものであること。三担保権により担保されておらず、かつ、発行者又は当該発行者と密接な関係を有する者による保証に係る特約その他の法的又は経済的に他の同順位の資本調達手段に対して優先的内容を有するものとするための特約が定められていないこと。四償還期限が定められている場合には、発行時から償還期限までの期間が五年以上であり、かつ、ステップ・アップ金利等に係る特約その他の償還等(償還期限が定められていないものの償還又は償還期限が定められているものの期限前償還をいう。次号において同じ。)を行う蓋然性を高める特約が定められていないこと。五償還等を行う場合には、発行後五年を経過した日以後(発行の目的に照らして償還等を行うことについてやむを得ない事由があると認められる場合にあっては、発行後)に発行者の任意によるときに限り償還等を行うことが可能であり、かつ、償還等又は買戻しに関する次に掲げる要件の全てを満たすものであること。イ償還等又は買戻しに際し、自己資本の充実について、あらかじめ金融庁長官の確認を受けるものとなっていること。ロ償還等又は買戻しについて期待を生じさせる行為を発行者が行っていないこと。ハその他次に掲げる要件のいずれかを満たすこと。(１)償還等又は買戻しが行われる場合には、発行者の収益性に照らして適切と認められる条件により、当該償還等又は買戻しのための資本調達(当該償還等又は買戻しが行われるものと同等以上の質が確保されるものに限る。)が当該償還等又は買戻しの時以前に行われること。(２)償還等又は買戻しの後においても発行者が十分な水準の最低所要連結自己資本規制比率を維持することが見込まれること。六発行者が債務の履行を怠った場合における期限の利益の喪失についての特約が定められていないこと。七剰余金の配当額又は利息の支払額が、発行後の発行者の信用状態を基礎として算定されるものでないこと。八発行者又は当該発行者の子法人等により取得されておらず、かつ、取得に必要な資金が発行者により直接又は間接に融通されたものでないこと。九特別目的会社等が発行する資本調達手段である場合には、発行代り金を利用するために発行される資本調達手段が前各号及び次号に掲げる要件の全て又は前条第四項各号に掲げる要件の全てを満たし、かつ、当該資本調達手段の発行者が発行代り金の全額を即時かつ無制限に利用可能であること。十元本の削減等又は公的機関による資金の援助その他これに類する措置が講ぜられなければ発行者が存続できないと認められる場合において、これらの措置が講ぜられる必要があると認められるときは、元本の削減等が行われる旨の特約が定められていること。ただし、法令の規定に基づいて、元本の削減等を行う措置が講ぜられる場合又は公的機関による資金の援助その他これに類する措置が講ぜられる前に当該発行者に生じる損失を完全に負担することとなる場合は、この限りでない。
text_en: "Tier 2 Capital instruments" as referred to in paragraph (1) and the preceding paragraph means capital instruments (excluding those that qualify as common shares or Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments) that satisfy all of the following requirements. (i) That they have been actually issued by the issuer and are fully paid up. (ii) That with respect to distribution of residual assets or repayment or modification of obligations in insolvency proceedings, they are subordinated to the issuer's other obligations (excluding obligations that qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments or Tier 2 Capital instruments). (iii) That they are not secured by collateral, and that there are no special provisions for guarantees by the issuer or persons in close relationship with the issuer or other provisions that are legally or economically designed to give priority over other instruments of the same rank. (iv) That, where a maturity date is specified, the period from issuance to maturity is five years or more, and that there are no provisions relating to step-up interest rates, etc. or other provisions that increase the probability of redemption, etc. (meaning redemption of instruments with no maturity date or early redemption of instruments with a specified maturity date; the same applies in the following item). (v) That, where redemption, etc. is carried out, redemption, etc. may only be carried out at the issuer's option on or after the date on which five years have elapsed from the date of issuance (or after issuance if there are unavoidable reasons for redemption, etc. in light of the purpose of issuance), and that all of the following requirements relating to redemption, etc. or buyback are satisfied. (a) That prior confirmation from the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency regarding capital adequacy is obtained at the time of redemption, etc. or buyback. (b) That the issuer has not taken any action that creates an expectation of redemption, etc. or buyback. (c) That either of the following requirements is satisfied: (1) In the case where redemption, etc. or buyback is carried out, capital raising for such redemption, etc. or buyback (limited to that which ensures quality at least equivalent to the instrument being redeemed, etc. or bought back) has been conducted prior to or at the time of such redemption, etc. or buyback, under conditions that are appropriate in light of the issuer's profitability. (2) That it is expected that the issuer will maintain a sufficient level of the minimum required consolidated capital adequacy ratio even after the redemption, etc. or buyback. (vi) That there are no provisions for acceleration of payment obligations in the event the issuer fails to perform its obligations. (vii) That the dividend amount or interest payment amount is not calculated based on the issuer's credit standing after issuance. (viii) That they have not been acquired by the issuer or a subsidiary of the issuer, and that the funds necessary for acquisition have not been directly or indirectly provided by the issuer. (ix) In the case of capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc., that the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds satisfy all of the requirements of the preceding items and the following item or all of the requirements of each item of paragraph (4) of the preceding Article, and that the issuer of such capital instruments may immediately and unconditionally use the entire proceeds. (x) That, where it is recognized that the issuer cannot continue to exist without write-down, etc. or public financial support or similar measures, and it is recognized that such measures need to be taken, provisions stipulating that write-down, etc. will be carried out are established; provided, however, that this shall not apply where, pursuant to the provisions of laws and regulations, measures to carry out write-down, etc. will be taken, or where the issuer will bear the full losses arising before public financial support or similar measures are provided.

clauses_en.text: "Tier 2 Capital instruments" as referred to in paragraph (1) and the preceding paragraph means capital instruments (excluding those that qualify as common shares or Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments) that satisfy all of the following requirements.
(i) That they have been actually issued by the issuer and are fully paid up.

(ii) That with respect to distribution of residual assets or repayment or modification of obligations in insolvency proceedings, they are subordinated to the issuer's other obligations (excluding obligations that qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments or Tier 2 Capital instruments).

(iii) That they are not secured by collateral, and that there are no special provisions for guarantees by the issuer or persons in close relationship with the issuer or other provisions that are legally or economically designed to give priority over other instruments of the same rank.

(iv) That, where a maturity date is specified, the period from issuance to maturity is five years or more, and that there are no provisions relating to step-up interest rates, etc. or other provisions that increase the probability of redemption, etc. (meaning redemption of instruments with no maturity date or early redemption of instruments with a specified maturity date; the same applies in the following item).

(v) That, where redemption, etc. is carried out, redemption, etc. may only be carried out at the issuer's option on or after the date on which five years have elapsed from the date of issuance (or after issuance if there are unavoidable reasons for redemption, etc. in light of the purpose of issuance), and that all of the following requirements relating to redemption, etc. or buyback are satisfied. (a) That prior confirmation from the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency regarding capital adequacy is obtained at the time of redemption, etc. or buyback. (b) That the issuer has not taken any action that creates an expectation of redemption, etc. or buyback. (c) That either of the following requirements is satisfied: (1) In the case where redemption, etc. or buyback is carried out, capital raising for such redemption, etc. or buyback (limited to that which ensures quality at least equivalent to the instrument being redeemed, etc. or bought back) has been conducted prior to or at the time of such redemption, etc. or buyback, under conditions that are appropriate in light of the issuer's profitability. (2) That it is expected that the issuer will maintain a sufficient level of the minimum required consolidated capital adequacy ratio even after the redemption, etc. or buyback.
(vi) That there are no provisions for acceleration of payment obligations in the event the issuer fails to perform its obligations.
(vii) That the dividend amount or interest payment amount is not calculated based on the issuer's credit standing after issuance.
(viii) That they have not been acquired by the issuer or a subsidiary of the issuer, and that the funds necessary for acquisition have not been directly or indirectly provided by the issuer.

(ix) In the case of capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc., that the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds satisfy all of the requirements of the preceding items and the following item or all of the requirements of each item of paragraph (4) of the preceding Article, and that the issuer of such capital instruments may immediately and unconditionally use the entire proceeds.

(x) That, where it is recognized that the issuer cannot continue to exist without write-down, etc. or public financial support or similar measures, and it is recognized that such measures need to be taken, provisions stipulating that write-down, etc. will be carried out are established;

provided, however, that this shall not apply where, pursuant to the provisions of laws and regulations, measures to carry out write-down, etc. will be taken, or where the issuer will bear the full losses arising before public financial support or similar measures are provided.
